summary: Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to announce a regular quarterly cash distribution of $0.14 per Beneficial Unit Certificate (BUC) declared by the Board of Managers of its general partner's general partner. The distribution is payable on July 31, 2026, to holders of record as of June 30, 2026, with ex-distribution date also June 30. The filing includes a press release as an exhibit. There is no M&A, restructuring, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. This is a routine operational announcement of a regular dividend, not a special situation.
